question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘resolve’

My cousin Nisha’s curiosity about life will never be satisfied because no one knows all the answers to all her questions.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Questions'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Resolve: To find a solution to a problem or question; to determine firmly. (समाधान करना)
 
 
• Example: The team worked together to resolve the conflict among the members.
 
 
 
• Questions: Sentences or phrases used to request information or to elicit a response. (प्रश्न)
